sources.notes: Rival components p.3 and six-player components p.7.

sources.notes: Components/module splits p.2; original-base exclusions p.3; Tech p.6; Rivals p.8.

sources.title: Dire Wolf Dune: Imperium resources
sources.notes: Links supplied editions and later FAQ; page content can change.

sources.title: Dune: Imperium Errata and Frequently Asked Questions
sources.notes: Publisher resources linked the exact 25-1-13 PDF. Recheck rulings before authoring faces; first-print corrections are edition-sensitive.
discrepancies: Missionaria Protectiva first-English-print faction-label omission is errata lineage. The FAQ establishes two total Imperium-deck copies, not two additional reprint copies; printed-face edition remains to audit.

sources.title: Dune Cards Hub
sources.notes: Index and sampled Bloodlines pages expose categories, module filters and copy counts, but HTML face pages expose images rather than verified semantic text; not authoritative.
discrepancies: Index includes Conspiracy and promos outside approved product scope; filter totals cannot stand for boxed inventory.
Bene Gesserit Sister page proposes two copies; pinned DuneBlend original row proposes three. No official per-identity count has resolved this.

sources.title: DuneBlend
sources.notes: resources.json has 12 category arrays; local resource_id repeats across arrays; user blend selections, ratings and compatibility strings are not official predicates. Six Bloodlines skill rows x2=12 versus official 14.
discrepancies: Bloodlines six Sardaukar skill rows at count 2 yield 12 physical copies; official B p.2 lists 14.
Broad Bloodlines compatibility strings do not encode B pp.2–3,6 module and original-base exclusions.
Original Bene Gesserit Sister row proposes three copies versus Cards Hub page two; matching 67-card aggregate does not settle the per-identity count.

sources.title: Dire Wolf fan art policy
sources.notes: Community discussion allowance does not establish permission for a copied dataset or card art; obtain specific rights review before import.

expectations.note: Four ordinary player sets; not a selected three-seat count.

Alphabetical list has 11 left and 11 right; corroborated by I pp.17–18. This is a location count, not 22 cards.

Control the Spice, one per player in Epic mode; not standard deck.
Two Experimentation copies replace two Dune, the Desert Planet; setup M p.5.
Separate contrasting-back contracts; not in ordinary 20-contract pool.
Two distinct 10-card Commander starting decks.
Not part of ordinary 18-card Bloodlines Intrigue pool.
Seven wood and seven plastic alternative representations; only seven used, not fourteen units.

One of six requires Tech Module.
